verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the ElevenLabs API, an Agents CLI, a hosted MCP server and an agents skill for AI coding assistants. None of it names an official SDK library (for example Python, JS or mobile packages) for building against ElevenLabs Agents. An API, CLI or MCP server is an adjacent interface rather than an SDK, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
